title: Krishna as the Ultimate Teacher: Illuminating Wisdom and Guiding Souls
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: Krishna, the revered and central figure of the epic Mahabharata, is hailed as the quintessential teacher. As the charioteer and advisor to the Pandava prince Arjuna, Krishna imparts profound wisdom and guidance, illuminating the path of righteousness, self-realization, and spiritual growth.
